observation: A modal popup is centred over the original page. It holds a 463px promo image (Promo_ads.jpg), has a circular close button at the top right, and sits on a grey dimming overlay that covers part of the hero and the intro. The AI-built page has no popup or overlay.

The contact details sit in a different top strip. The original opens with a dark utility bar (rgb(29,29,29)): the organisation name and FontAwesome social glyphs are on the left, and the phone '0700CALLNIRA' and email are in green on the right. The AI-built page uses a white top strip: the logo is on the left and a two-line contact block is right-aligned on the right (gray 'Phone:' label with a green number, then 'admin@nira.org.ng · Webmail'). The AI-built page repeats these details in the footer.
Both pages place the same small 80x57 logo PNG at the top left of the header (x≈150 in the original, x=180 in the AI-built page).

The main navigation is styled differently. The original puts it in a light grey header band to the right of the logo, with active HOME in green, small dropdown chevrons on most items, and thin vertical dividers. The AI-built page uses a separate full-width solid green bar (rgb(0,135,81)) with plain white text links and no dropdowns or icons. Its 8 links are left-aligned and 'Switchto.ng' is set apart at the far right.

Label casing differs. The original sets navigation and sidebar labels in letter-spaced uppercase at a lighter weight (HOME, WHO ARE WE, 'QUICK MENU', 'NIRA CALENDAR', 'SWITCHTO.NG'). The AI-built page uses title or sentence case (Home, Who Are We, 'Events calendar · May 2021').

The hero is built differently. The original hero is a full-width image slider of .ng category banners (sch, gov, 8, name_zone, mobi, edu, i_ng; 1440x432). The visible slide is a green-apple photo, and its headline '.sch.ng Domains' is baked into the raster. The AI-built hero is a full-width diagonal green gradient band with no image, holding a live white H1, a short paragraph, and a button, left-aligned at x=196.

The slider controls differ. The original hero has faint prev/next arrows at its edges for an actual multi-slide carousel. The AI-built hero has three indicator dots (one filled) at the far left edge, outside the content column, but only one slide of content.

Both pages have exactly one H1, but it differs. In the original the H1 is empty (36px, weight 800, green rgb(43,182,115), Open Sans), and the visible title is an h2. In the AI-built page the H1 reads 'Welcome to the .ng Domain Registry' (44.8px, weight 700, white, system-ui).

The heading outline differs. The original jumps between levels: empty h1, then h3s, then h2s for welcome/register/policies, then an h3 newsletter heading, an h4 'NEWS UPDATE', and h3 footer headings. The AI-built page runs 1 H1, 3 H2s, then 11 H3s used for card titles and footer columns.

Landmark usage differs. The original has no header, nav, main or aside elements; it is mostly divs (242), with 5 sections, 3 articles and 1 footer. The AI-built page has 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 5 sections, 2 articles and 1 footer.

The CSS approach differs. The original uses 607 class uses (155 unique), 120 inline style attributes, 6 style blocks and 12 stylesheets, consistent with a CMS template. The AI-built page uses 55 class uses (25 unique), 9 inline styles and 1 stylesheet.

The content container width differs: the original uses a centred container of about 1140px starting at x≈150, and the AI-built page uses a centred column of about 1048px (x=196 to 1244). Backgrounds are full-bleed on the AI-built page.

The column structure differs. The original body is a single row of 4 columns of about 292px each (left sidebar, two content columns, right sidebar), built without grid or flex (display_grid 0, display_flex 0). The AI-built page stacks card rows using grid and flex (grid 4, flex 11): two 514px cards, then an equal-height (443px) calendar and news pair, then a row of three 336px cards.

The quick links (Whois Search, Registrars, Search, Contact Us) are placed differently. The original lists them in a left sidebar 'QUICK MENU' with chevron bullets and hairline dividers. The AI-built page shows them as a horizontal white strip of bold green links directly under the hero, repeated in the footer.

Both pages include a month-view events calendar fixed on May 2021, with Mon–Sun column headers and previous/next year and month navigation. On both it is stale relative to the © 2019 footer and the current date.

The calendar styling differs. The original is a small sidebar widget with arrow nav controls, a rounded grey outer border, and day 25 highlighted in a bordered box. The AI-built page uses a large table (468px wide) inside a card, with about 67x47 cells, gray gridlines, a pale green header row, 5 empty leading cells, and text-link navigation ('« Year', '‹ Month', 'Month ›', 'Year »').

The typefaces differ. The original pairs the Open Sans (412 elements) and ABeeZee (233 elements) web fonts, with 14px body text on a 24px line height. The AI-built page uses a single system-ui stack (229 elements, plus Arial on 3), with 16px body text on a 25.6px line height and no web fonts.
The H2 size differs: 24px at weight 600 in the original, and 44.8px at weight 700 in the AI-built page, which the facts record as equal to the H1.

Both palettes use a single green accent, but the tones differ. The original uses a pure white background, neutral dark grey text rgb(51,51,51), and green rgb(43,182,115) for links, active nav and headings, plus grey rgb(153,153,153). The AI-built page uses a green-tinted near-white background rgb(246,249,247), green-black text rgb(28,43,36), and brand green rgb(0,135,81) for fills, with a darker rgb(0,95,57) for links and headings.

The news block differs. The original right sidebar has a ticker-style box under 'NEWS UPDATE' with real bold uppercase green headlines (e.g. 'PANTAMI INAUGURATES NCC EMERGENCY...') and small prev/next arrows. The AI-built 'News updates' card lists placeholder items 'News item 1/2/3', each with the same 32x32 bc-lr.png arrow image and hairline dividers between them.

The newsletter block differs. The original shows an uppercase heading with a single centred green 'Subscribe' text link and no form (buttons 0). The AI-built page has a full-width card with an H3, a wide email input with the placeholder 'Your email address', and a solid green 'Subscribe' button.

The register and policy blocks differ. The original pairs small 55px icons (ngReg.png, policy.png), floated left, with paragraphs that wrap around them, as plain columns. The AI-built page uses two side-by-side 514px cards, each with an image at left (a 149x155 registrar badge and a 100x100 circular icon) and text at right.

The inline call-to-action links differ. The original ends paragraphs with a green 'Read More.' link. The AI-built page uses underlined green links with an arrow ('Learn more →', 'Read the policy development document (PDF) →'), and on one of them the arrow wraps onto its own line.
In the AI-built page's 3R copy, the words 'Registry', 'Registrar' and 'Registrant' are set bold and brand green inside running text.

Both pages embed a native HTML5 video with default browser controls, but they differ. The original's is 300px wide in the right sidebar, with a dark poster showing the .ng logo and a 3:04 duration. The AI-built page's is 468x150 at the bottom of the news card, with no poster, so it shows as a black rounded box at 0:00 with empty space below it.

The intro section differs. In the original, the intro sits under the h2 'Welcome to the .ng Domain Registry website.' as 14px/24px muted grey text describing NiRA as a not-for-profit, self-regulating body. In the AI-built page, it sits under a green H2 'About NiRA' as a single paragraph capped at about 760px, on the page background with no card.

The footer differs. The original footer is a near-black panel (rgb(15,10,10)) with four columns (Registrars, Policy Compliance, Support, Follow us on :), large white headings of about 24px, and stacks of green links. The AI-built footer is a dark green-black block (rgb(28,43,36)) with three columns (Contact, Follow NiRA, Quick links), white bold H3s, and white underlined links.

The registrar, policy compliance and support link lists are placed differently. In the original they are footer columns. In the AI-built page they are a row of three bordered body cards, each with an H3 and three underlined links separated by hairlines.
Both pages use glossy, full-colour 32x32 raster PNG social icons in a tight row (Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Google, Instagram), with no SVG icons.

Image alt text differs. In the original, 8 of 17 images lack alt, including the social icons, and the Instagram icon's alt is misspelled 'instragram'. In the AI-built page, all 11 images have alt attributes (alt_missing 0) and the logo's alt is descriptive. The AI-built page adds 'LinkedIn' and 'NiRA on Facebook' text links next to the icons.

Both pages carry the same copyright text, '© 2019 Nigeria Internet Registration Association (NiRA). All Rights Reserved.', but present it differently. The original puts it in a separate solid dark green band (rgb(0,102,0)) with centred white text and a black 'Webmail' link. The AI-built page puts it in a small line inside the dark footer, below a thin rule.
ARIA usage differs: the original has 0 ARIA attributes, and the AI-built page has 15.
Script and markup weight differs. The original has 43 script tags, a base tag, noscript fallbacks and an iframe. The AI-built page has 1 script and 1 stylesheet.

The effects differ. The original uses 25 box-shadows, 189 transitions and 2 transforms, with no gradients. The AI-built page uses 0 shadows, 0 transitions and 0 transforms, with 1 gradient (the hero). Both have mostly square corners (619 vs 210 at radius 0), 1 animation, and no backdrop blur.
The AI-built page groups its content into uniform cards: white fill, thin light border, roughly 8–12px rounded corners, and no shadow. The original groups content into plain columns without cards.

The buttons differ. The AI-built page has real button elements (4), including an inverted hero CTA 'Who are we' (white fill, dark green text, 6px radius, 10px 20px padding) and a green filled 'Subscribe' button. The original has no button elements; its closest is the transparent 'Previous Year' calendar control.
Links in the AI-built body are consistently underlined green text, used for cards, lists and calendar navigation, with white underlined links in the footer. Underlining is the main link cue there.

The AI-built page follows a regular vertical rhythm: 20px gutters between paired cards and about 45px between card rows. Its surfaces alternate subtly between rgb(246,249,247), white and rgb(250,252,251).

Page length differs. The original is short at 1388px tall, stacking a utility bar, header, hero, one content row, a footer and a copyright strip. The AI-built page is 2193px tall, stacking a header, hero, quick-link bar, several card rows, a newsletter card and a footer.

The document metadata differs. The original uses lang 'en-gb' and the long title 'Welcome to the .ng Domain Registry website - Nigeria internet Registration Association (NiRA)', plus a generator meta. The AI-built page uses lang 'en', the title 'NiRA | .ng Domain Registry', and a description meta. Neither page has JSON-LD.

Both pages use institutional, informational copy of similar length (324 vs 304 words), built on registry, registrar, policy and compliance terminology, with no large lifestyle photography beyond the original's hero banner.
